name: VidPal
summary: Autonomous content engine for faceless and topic-based channels: it discovers trending stories in your niche, auto-generates short-form videos and carousels with AI voiceovers, and auto-publishes them across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more.
best_for: creators and small brands running faceless or topic-based channels that want the trend-find, generate and auto-publish loop handled in one tool across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
skip_if: you want hands-on creative control over every video, or your brand can't afford auto-published AI content going out without a human check
honest_knock: Credits don't carry over month to month, and a few users report slow support/account responses — so run the free plan through a full create-and-publish loop before you pay.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed annually ($144/yr), or $24 monthly
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-01 against the vendor's own pricing page) (2026) Free: 4 lifetime credits, standard-quality exports, "Made with Vidpal.ai" watermark, no card. Starter $12/mo billed annually ($144/yr) or $24 monthly, 15 credits/mo; Pro $23/mo annually ($276/yr) or $46 monthly, 40 credits, auto-publish and scheduling, 2K exports; Business $41/mo annually ($492/yr) or $82 monthly, 100 credits, 4K, three daily slots; Enterprise on quote. One credit is a Reel, a carousel, an editing upload or ten minutes of clip source; an AI Avatar or long-form video is five. Monthly credits do not roll over, annual credits arrive as a yearly pool, and top-up packs expire after 60 days. Refunds cover the unused credit balance within 30 days.
